title: Addressing the Code reviewer
description: How to write for a reader acting as Code reviewer. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `code-reviewer` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Name the reference that does not resolve, and where it points
rules.description: Name the reference that does not resolve, and where it points. 'This looks wrong' is not reviewable; 'this declares X, and X is declared nowhere' is.

source.quote: Reads a node, not a program. Knows the graph's vocabulary and expects a node to declare what it is; does not know why this one was written and should not have to guess. The failure they are hunting is a node that looks well-formed and resolves to nothing — which no test catches, because nothing ran.
